title: Fee Deduction Concurrency with Open Positions
precondition: Sub-account has active open trades during monthly fee settlement.
steps: 1. Deduct fee from free margin cash.
expected_result: Free margin decreases safely; margin level verified before debit to prevent triggering stop-out.
actual_result: Fee settlement checks free margin before executing cash debit, preventing fee deduction from triggering margin stop-outs.
